description: Grass has the end of the Gate Road, the tarmac broken up under it and going nowhere. There's a square of scorched rockcrete where the South Gate stood before it moved west to Meltwater Row, and the sawn-off stumps of two turret masts. The Architect's Curtain seals the edge here: a floor-to-sky sheet of humming hard light. There's no way through but the South Gate.
name: Grasslands
